name: Zufar's Notes
description: Working notes by Zufar Dhiyaulhaq: TIL (today I learned) entries and engineering guides on Kubernetes, service mesh, databases, home-lab infrastructure, and cloud operations.

resources.markdown_twins: Each page is also available as plain Markdown for agents at its path plus index.md (e.g. https://notes.zufardhiyaulhaq.com/index.md).

note: notes.zufardhiyaulhaq.com is a static documentation site (MkDocs). It publishes notes and guides and does not expose a callable agent endpoint: there is no A2A agent, no MCP server, no API, and no OAuth here. This manifest describes the site only as a content resource for AI agents. The resources listed above are plain files an agent can read directly.
